## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/object/exportentry">ExportEntry</a> encapsulates the current-state-of-the-walk used when doing a non-recursive walk of the trie data structure.</p>


<p>This allows you to iterate across all exported symbols using: <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/error">Error</a> Err = <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/error/#a4dfd0813c3d0e0a30439b5a3e9196b59">Error::success()</a>; for (const <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/object/exportentry">llvm::object::ExportEntry</a> &amp;AnExport : Obj-&gt;exports(&amp;Err)) { } if (Err) { report error ...</p>
